verdict.rationale: Runpod's public pricing page lists per-hour GPU prices across Community and Secure Cloud, for example 'B300 ... $8.99/hr', and on-demand use is self-serve without sales contact. Only one GPU's price is evidenced, so the 'every GPU type' part of the story is unproven, and reserved or contract pricing is routed to enterprise sales. Missing for 10: evidence that per-GPU-hour prices are published for every GPU type, publicly listed reserved/contract pricing without a sales conversation, independent corroboration of the pricing page's completeness.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can see the published per-GPU-hour price for every GPU type on a public pricing page without talking to sales
